mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, ended_at, end_reason, commitment_at, revision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS reqId, r.name AS projectName, v.id AS versionId, v.name AS versionName, v.status AS versionStatus, v.start_date AS startDate, v.target_date AS targetDate, v.released_at AS releasedAt, v.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT u.display_name FROM app_user u WHERE u.id = r.owner_user_id) AS ownerName, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vt.task_id) FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vt.version_id = v.id AND t.req_id = v.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column <> 'canceled') AS taskCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vt.task_id) FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vt.version_id = v.id AND t.req_id = v.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done') AS doneTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vt.task_id) FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vt.version_id = v.id AND t.req_id = v.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND (t.estimate_minutes IS NULL OR t.estimate_minutes = 0)) AS unestimatedTaskCount, /* 需求覆盖与发布检查同口径：已关闭/驳回/取消的需求退出分母，有用例才算覆盖 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND d.req_id = v.req_id AND d.version_id = v.id AND d.status NOT IN ('closed', 'rej', 'canceled')) AS demandCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND d.req_id = v.req_id AND d.version_id = v.id AND d.status NOT IN ('closed', 'rej', 'canceled') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_case c WHERE c.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND c.req_id = d.req_id AND c.demand_id = d.id)) AS coveredDemandCount, /* 下一计划：未取消/未完成的最早计划；兼容旧的单版本计划字段 */ (SELECT p.planned_at FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND p.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'completed') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version x WHERE x.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND x.plan_id = p.id AND x.version_id = v.id) OR (p.version_id = v.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version y WHERE y.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND y.plan_id = p.id))) ORDER BY (p.planned_at IS NULL), p.planned_at, p.id LIMIT 1) AS nextPlanAt, (SELECT p.environment FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND p.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'completed') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version x WHERE x.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND x.plan_id = p.id AND x.version_id = v.id) OR (p.version_id = v.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version y WHERE y.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND y.plan_id = p.id))) ORDER BY (p.planned_at IS NULL), p.planned_at, p.id LIMIT 1) AS nextPlanEnvironment, (SELECT p.status FROM version_release_plan p WHERE p.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND p.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'completed') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version x WHERE x.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND x.plan_id = p.id AND x.version_id = v.id) OR (p.version_id = v.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version y WHERE y.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND y.plan_id = p.id))) ORDER BY (p.planned_at IS NULL), p.planned_at, p.id LIMIT 1) AS nextPlanStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release vr WHERE vr.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vr.version_id = v.id AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND vr.operation IN ('deploy', 'redeploy')) AS productionSuccessCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release vr WHERE vr.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vr.version_id = v.id AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'staging') AS stagingSuccessCount, (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(vr.published_on, DATE(vr.occurred_at))) FROM version_release vr WHERE vr.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vr.version_id = v.id AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND vr.operation IN ('deploy', 'redeploy')) AS latestReleaseDate, /* 交付说明确认是四个键的全部具备（摘要/变更/缺陷/验收），与交付页「待确认」同一口径 */ (SELECT CASE WHEN JSON_CONTAINS(dn.confirmed, '"summary"') AND JSON_CONTAINS(dn.confirmed, '"change"') AND JSON_CONTAINS(dn.confirmed, '"issue"') AND JSON_CONTAINS(dn.confirmed, '"acceptance"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM delivery_note dn WHERE dn.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND dn.version_id = v.id LIMIT 1) AS deliveryConfirmed FROM project_version v INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND r.id = v.req_id WHERE v.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.updated_at DESC, v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_version (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, ended_at, end_reason, commitment_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{targetDate}, #{releasedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{endReason}, #{commitmentAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE project_version SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, target_date = #{targetDate}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE project_version SET status = #{status}, ended_at = NOW(), end_reason = #{reason}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE project_version SET commitment_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND commitment_at IS NULL
UPDATE project_version SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_version WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plan SET version_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
